changelog: Roll automatically plays the selected song when the reel lands; scratch/reveal has been removed.
Removed Spotify playlist import and its login flow. YouTube Music, Deeplist-link and CSV/song-list imports remain available.
Refreshed Library cards show real counts and artwork, with Recently Added and Liked cards.
Optional Artwork lyrics mode adds an oversized curved cover and glass controls while preserving saved Apple lyrics preferences.
Profile adds real listening collections and avatar interactions; Google login and account sync are preserved.
